## Changed behavior

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For fixes, give the original failure and the regression test that reproduces it.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. Register new test entrypoints in `tests/suites.json`.
Attach screenshots for UI changes.

## Remaining limitations

List skipped checks (with reasons), platform limitations, and follow-up work.

Merging requires an up-to-date branch, resolved review conversations, and the successful **Quality gate** check. Independent approval is optional; self-merge is supported.
